datatable.errors.title: Data table with structural errors:
datatable.error.duplicateDirective: Line {line}: directive '{detail}' appears more than once
datatable.error.badColumnLabel: Line {line}: invalid display label in column definition '{detail}' (expected: identifier, then the text in double quotes)
datatable.error.unknownTypesValue: Line {line}: unknown value '{detail}' for the type display (allowed: shown, hidden)
datatable.error.badFormat: Line {line}: invalid display format in '{detail}' (allowed: number with 0 to 10 decimal places)
datatable.error.duplicateColumn: Line {line}: column name '{detail}' appears more than once
datatable.error.aggregateTypeMismatch: Line {line}: aggregate does not match the column type ({detail})
datatable.error.rowCellCount: Line {line}: cell count differs from the data columns ({detail})
datatable.error.invalidLine: Line {line}: neither directive nor data row: '{detail}'
datatable.error.computedBadRef: Line {line}: column expression references an unknown column ({detail})
datatable.error.computedCycle: Line {line}: circular reference between computed columns ({detail})
datatable.cellError.invalidNumber: Invalid number (expected: decimal point notation, e.g. 12.5)
datatable.cellError.invalidBoolean: Invalid boolean value (expected: x or empty)
datatable.cellError.computedTypeMismatch: Expression result does not match the column type
datatable.rowLimit: Large table with {total} rows: only header and aggregates are shown
datatable.hint.notFound: Data table not unambiguously found in the source, change discarded
datatable.hint.blocked: Data table has structural errors, editing only in the source
datatable.filter.show: Show or hide the filter row
